answer: This system resists Sybil attacks through a sequential delay proof that each identity completes separately before earning weight. At enrollment, a cedar disc is coated with pigment in a 2-millimeter layer and a vine strand 30 centimeters long is pressed into the coating; the disc waits 6 hours in open air, then the pigment color is measured and the vine is pulled free. A color shift outside a preset range or an impression under 30 centimeters voids the attempt, so 100 fakes need 100 separate discs and 100 separate 6-hour waits.
